title: CISA: Hackers chain Plex flaws in Plex2Shell attacks to breach servers
description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency is warning that attackers are actively exploiting four vulnerabilities in Plex Media Server.

title: Severe Weather Warning for North East and Central North
description: Damaging winds are forecast for Launceston and the Central North this afternoon.

title: Hobart East residents question lack of total fire ban amid fire fears
description: Residents east of Hobart are criticising authorities for not enforcing a total fire ban despite fears of nearby blazes.

title: Plex now helps sell movie theater tickets
description: Plex is expanding its services to include movie ticket sales, aiming to be a central content discovery platform.
